notes: Prices in USD per 1M tokens, standard (non-batch) API tier. Tiered-price models record the base (lowest) tier with the higher tier in the model's note field. Retired models excluded; deprecated-but-available models included. Collected Monday 2026-10-05, 7 days after the previous file. Tracked scope follows the set established on 2026-07-16 so week-over-week deltas stay meaningful. The set grows from 51 to 53 rows: two models arrived, nothing left, and no row was replaced. Every one of the 51 carried rows is unchanged on input, output and cache-read price — a sixth consecutive week with no price change on the carried set, across all six providers. The two arrivals are Claude Sonnet 5.5 (claude-sonnet-5-5) at $2.00/$10.00 with cache read $0.20 and a 1M context window, and gpt-6.1-sol at $2.00/$10.00 with cache read $0.10. Both enter at exactly the input and output price of the model they succeed in the same line — Claude Sonnet 5 and gpt-6-sol respectively — so unlike the 2026-09-28 arrivals, neither lowers the headline per-token price of its tier. The one price difference is gpt-6.1-sol's cache read: $0.10 against gpt-6-sol's $0.20, a 0.05x multiplier where gpt-6-sol uses 0.1x, the same move Claude Opus 5.5 made on 2026-09-28. For a cache-heavy workload the successor is cheaper even though its list price is identical. Claude Sonnet 5.5 keeps the standard 0.1x multiplier and matches Claude Sonnet 5 on every line of the Anthropic table, cache writes and batch included. Neither predecessor was removed: Claude Sonnet 5 and gpt-6-sol are both still listed at unchanged prices. OpenAI moved gpt-6.1-sol into the three-row flagship table in gpt-6-sol's place; gpt-6-sol now appears only in the full model table. One carried row changed status without changing price: Anthropic deprecated claude-sonnet-4-5 on 2026-09-30 and scheduled its retirement for 2026-11-30, naming claude-sonnet-5-5 as the replacement. The row stays in the set as deprecated-but-available. The pricing page labels only retired models, so the status comes from Anthropic's model deprecations page, read the same day. Claude Sonnet 5.5 falls under the Anthropic page's tokenizer statement (Claude 4.7 and later), so the affected row count rises from nine to ten. Newly recorded, with no price effect: the DeepSeek page states that peak hours (01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC) apply Monday through Friday excluding Chinese public holidays, with weekends and those holidays off-peak in full. This is the first snapshot to record that qualifier; whether the page carried it before 2026-10-05 was not established (the archived copy of 2026-09-25 did not contain the pricing table). The DeepSeek page also no longer carries the statement that deepseek-v4-pro API service continues after 2026-09-14 with billing unchanged; the model and its price are still listed. Also observed and outside the rows: OpenAI now lists gpt-5.6-sol in a 'Cyber models' table described as its latest Daybreak models, alongside gpt-5.6-cyber ($12.50/$75.00, cached input $1.25), while gpt-5.6-sol stays in the full model table at the same $4.00/$20.00 — the row is kept as a general text model; Mistral lists Leanstral 1.5, a Lean 4 proof-engineering model, as a free endpoint for a limited period with no per-token price, so there is no paid rate to record; Google lists Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS, Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS and Gemini 3.8 Live, which fall under the TTS and live exclusions. Still observed and still out of the rows, unchanged from 2026-09-28: Gemini Omni Flash and Gemini Omni Flash Preview (video models, $1.50 input, $9.00 text / $17.50 video output); Gemma 4 with no paid tier; Mistral's two third-party GLM resales (GLM 5.3 and GLM 5.2, both $1.40/$4.40), excluded per the 2026-09-21 decision; Ministral 3 in three sizes (3B $0.10/$0.10, 8B $0.15/$0.15, 14B $0.20/$0.20); OpenAI gpt-5.2 and earlier; and Google's image, embedding, TTS, video, live and transcription models. Carried statements unchanged this week: Claude 4.7 and later models and Claude Mythos Preview use a newer tokenizer the page says produces approximately 30% more tokens for the same text, with the exact increase depending on content and workload shape — per-token prices are unchanged, so the ten affected rows (claude-opus-4-7, claude-opus-4-8, claude-opus-5, claude-opus-5-5, claude-sonnet-5, claude-sonnet-5-5, claude-fable-5, claude-fable-5-1, claude-mythos-5, claude-mythos-5-1) cost more per unit of text than a per-token comparison against a 4.6-and-earlier row shows; DeepSeek still accepts the legacy ids deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp while serving both from DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash at Flash pricing; the three Gemini Flash rows at $0.75/$3.75 still carry a 2026-12-31 introductory expiry that doubles them on 2027-01-01; Anthropic still states the Claude Sonnet 5 $2/$10 rate is standard and that the cancelled 2026-09-01 increase will not occur; and OpenAI still states gpt-5.6-sol's promotional pricing is available at least through 2026-11-21.
